name: Account
summary: Gathers the entries of one classification and answers for them, so that a value's history is kept rather than only its present total.

roles.name: Account
roles.summary: A container of entries that is more than a container: it answers a balance, and a balance as at any past moment, because it holds every discrete change rather than a running figure. That is what makes it the history of a value and not a field holding one.

roles.name: Entries
roles.summary: The entries gathered here. An entry is put into an account when it is created, and the account is the one place that decides which entries belong together.

roles.name: Balance
roles.summary: What the entries add up to, over all time or over a stated range. It is derived from the entries rather than stored beside them, so it cannot disagree with them.
